description: Checks that glide.knowman.apply_article_read_criteria is set to true. When false (the default), users with Can Contribute access at the KB level bypass ALL article-level Can Read and Cannot Read user criteria. This defeats the purpose of setting article-level restrictions for sensitive content within a shared knowledge base and is a prerequisite for effective article-level access segmentation.
name: cstaces-11b prop-apply-article-criteria
resolution_details: Set glide.knowman.apply_article_read_criteria to true in sys_properties.list. Verify that KB contributors can no longer read articles restricted by article-level Cannot Read criteria. Note: this may change existing contributor behavior, so coordinate with knowledge managers before enabling.
